'''Andrew Sutherland Total TIGIH''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Andrew Sutherland]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-15643">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15643 Total TIGIH], DeckTech (Andrew "Harc Serf" Sutherland, 29 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15643/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15643/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Andrew Sutherland]]
* '''Published:''' 29 April 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Total TIGIH''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif|label=There Is Good In Him}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 TIGIH Sutherland LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This deck has everything you need to run a good TIGIH, Fallen Portals, Insertions, Dbays...

== Original post ==

'''Total TIGIH'''
* '''Author:''' Andrew "Harc Serf" Sutherland
* '''Published:''' April 29, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' This deck has everything you need to run a good TIGIH, Fallen Portals, Insertions, Dbays...

=== Strategy ===

Usual stuff

==== Starting ====

TIGIH/ICSH

Chief Chirpa's Hut

LSJK

Luke's Stick

Endor Docking Bay

I Feel The Conflict

Heading For...

Insurrection

Squadron Assignments

Strike Planning

Turn 1

Grab Madine and activate and search for a docking bay, and deploy all sites in hand.  Move Luke to Endor DB at the end of your turn.

Turn 2

Deploy Madine. Try to set up effects and a fallen portal/insertion planning, then just grab scouts and just play it like a normal deck.

Try to set up big drains at back door, like Lightsaber Prof., Ithorian, Midge, LSJK with Saber and Ani's Saber. thats a drain of 7 right there-)Get Talas out and Close Air. Destiny Layout(after starting)

0=6

1=11

2=14

3=6

4=6

5=4

6=4

I can't think of much now, I'll add when you ask about stuff
